newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NYBB KEEPS 'BUY' ON MOL, TECHNICALS.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NYBB KEEPS 'BUY' ON MOL, TECHNICALS.

text.p: Hungarian securities house New York Broker Budapest (NYBB) maintained its "short-term buy" recommendation on oil company MOL shares and said it was a "buy" for the next six months as well, on technicals.
"MOL's limit price was 4,000 forints," said analyst Balint Hada in a technical analysis dated July 2. "If MOL's price goes down to 3,900 forints, then it's a 'strong buy'," he said.
Hada, referring to a point and figure chart, said it was "time to buy because the MOL price is nearly the support line of uptrend."
On Thursday MOL shares finished at 4,190 forints, up five.
